title: Stop running. You’re tired because you were never meant to carry the weight of your life alone. You’ve tried different paths, different identities, and different distractions, but that empty space remains. That’s not emptiness; that’s room for Him.
paragraphs: Stop running. You’re tired because you were never meant to carry the weight of your life alone. You’ve tried different paths, different identities, and different distractions, but that empty space remains. That’s not emptiness; that’s room for Him.
The moment you stop fighting His call is the moment your real life begins. Surrender isn’t weakness; it’s the ultimate act of a warrior catching their breath before the real mission starts. ⚔️✝️
🔥 "Where can I go from Your Spirit? Or where can I flee from Your presence? If I ascend into heaven, You are there; If I make my bed in hell, behold, You are there." — Psalm 139:7-8
Are you ready to stop running and start walking in your purpose?
